subject.title: feat: add editable voice dictation to the Control UI

question: Should editable Control UI dictation be accepted as a Gateway/provider-backed core Control UI feature once proof and patch defects are fixed, or should it be deferred to broader WebChat voice work?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-visible microphone workflow and authenticated Gateway audio method, which is a product/security boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
options.body: Proceed with this direction after the branch is ported to current main, the two patch defects are fixed, and successful real browser/Gateway proof is posted.

options.title: Defer behind broader voice work
options.body: Keep the paired issue open but pause this PR until maintainers settle the broader WebChat STT/TTS and Talk/dictation boundary.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Close this implementation path and direct users to existing Talk or external dictation workflows until core voice priorities change.

recommendation.title: Accept Gateway-backed dictation after fixes
recommendation.body: Proceed with this direction after the branch is ported to current main, the two patch defects are fixed, and successful real browser/Gateway proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest feature-history signal is the prior merged server-side dictation work and media pipeline refactor.
